reuse.why: Replaces the two inline holiday checks in server/schedules/app.ts with a local helper, but does not export or reuse the holiday test that shared/schedules.ts already owns (isSkippedDay) and that app.ts already imports from.

duplication.why: The MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD matching (dayFromDate, slice(5), some(=== day || === monthDay)) is written twice: in the new isHoliday in app.ts and inline in isSkippedDay in shared/schedules.ts.

placement.why: The holiday-matching rule belongs in shared/schedules.ts next to isSkippedDay; the change puts a second definition in the server schedules app.

scope.why: Focused on holiday matching and its tests, though it also changes an unrelated existing test's frequency from weekly to daily.

maintainability.why: A future change to the holiday format must be made in two places that can silently diverge.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts defines its own isHoliday instead of exporting and using the holiday check in shared/schedules.ts (isSkippedDay).

disguised_duplication.where: The copy in isHoliday (app.ts) and isSkippedDay (shared/schedules.ts) is near-verbatim, not disguised.
